Moody's revised outlook to Positive reflecting improved operating performance and stronger balance sheet metrics.

operating_metrics_fy2016.notes: Large freestanding children's hospital, ~50%+ Medicaid. CA provider fee material to operating margin.

_research_notes: AFFIRM POSITIVE OUTLOOK in window. Baa2 maintained, Moody's revised outlook Stable -> Positive in mid-2019. Heavy Medi-Cal exposure but improving metrics.
